title: The CycleMin entry excursion forces a finance tax above the relaxed OE/OOE minimum that kills 25781 at N0=10^6
statement: Every CycleMin cycle contains an entry excursion O^a E into the distinguished minimum n whose predecessor valley has finance cost at least a positive delta above the relaxed oe_start_min / n-valley classes, or that entry conflicts with the cyclic closing edge of the finance-optimal necklace at (L,o)=(25781,16266), and that delta charged at the unique entry (and not an archived last-even / F2(v)>v / oe_start / terminal-(2,1) cell) makes parity_excludes or budget_excludes kill 25781 at the published floor N0=10^6.
counterexamples: 100000135 = oe_start_min(1000001) enters n by OE with peak 1000002025000; 33 entry valleys all a=1, tax 0 at the cheap end
n and n+2 do not enter n under O^a E for a<=4; every-valley entry compatibility is false
first a=2 start 1000057 peaks at 3.16e13 > (n+1)^2 and lands at 5623773; a>=2 fibre empty
2764 * 7.4e-16 still inside slack 5.63e-4; packed word already ends OE
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / CycleMin entry excursion
notes: Phase 0 only. The entry tube is the archived OE cell at oe_start_min. No K=11, no 1054k, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: n=10^6+1; O^a E for a<=4; six odds in [10^6+1, 10^6+2001] stride 400; packed suffix at L=25781; first a=2 start 1000057
